subject: Archaeology
title: Dwarka: Krishna's Sunken City
description: A quick win: understand Dwarka: Krishna's Sunken City.

hook.text: Hindu scripture says the god Krishna's golden city sank beneath the waves.

buildup.text: The Mahabharata places Dwarka on India's western coast in Gujarat.

discovery.text: Marine archaeologists found stone walls, anchors, and pottery off the Gujarat coast dating to around 1500 BCE.

twist.text: The ruins cannot prove the mythological story, but they do prove a significant ancient port existed at the legendary.

climax.text: Millions of pilgrims visit the Dwarka temple each year, convinced the underwater city is Krishna's real kingdom.

punchline.text: Myth described a sunken city. The sea floor had one waiting to be found.

quiz.question: What is the archaeological challenge with Dwarka?
options: The site is too deep for divers to properly investigate
The ruins confirm an ancient port but cannot prove the mythological story
Modern construction has completely destroyed the underwater evidence
